title: 第8章 八千万到账，目标大特区-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》
content:
第(1/3)页

    六月的江城像一口蒸笼，盖子捂得死死的，热气往骨头缝里钻。

    翡翠花园的中央空调二十四小时不停，客厅里凉快得像另一个季节。

    但林母还是改不了老习惯，一大早就把所有窗户推开通风，被林川按回去三次。

    “妈，开空调就别开窗了呗”

    “电费不要钱啊？”

    “害，咱家也不差这点。”

    林母嘴上嘟囔着“败家”，手已经老老实实把窗户关上了。

    六月七号。

    高考第一天。

    林川一早把车开到小区门口等着。林小冉从单元门出来的时候，马尾扎得很高，背着一个洗得发白的帆布书包，脚步比平时快。

    她拉开车门坐进来，安全带还没系好，就低头翻准考证。

    “紧张？”

    “还好。”林小冉的声音稳，但林川注意到她左手一直在搓校服的下摆。

    “考完请你吃火锅。”

    “哥，你每次鼓励人的方式就是请吃东西。”

    “管用就行。”

    车子在江城一中门口停下的时候，校门外已经围了一大片家长。

    有举着向日葵的，有举着横幅的，还有一个大妈拿着个大喇叭在喊“旗开得胜”。

    林小冉推开车门，走了两步，又回头。

    “哥。”

    “嗯？”

    “我会超常发挥的。”

    说完转身就跑进了校门，马尾辫在阳光底下一甩一甩的。

    林川坐在车里，点了根烟，看着校门口那片嘈杂的人群。

    两天。

    考完这两天，他在江城最后一层牵挂就算暂时放下了。

    六月九号，高考结束。

    林小冉从考场出来的时候，整个人像被抽走了骨头似的，软塌塌地靠在车座上，闭着眼睛，嘴角却是弯的。

    “感觉怎么样？”

    “数学最后一道大题第三问没写完。”

    “那就是稳了。”

    “凭什么？”

    “最后一问本来就是给满分的人准备的，正常人做不完才正常。”

    林小冉睁开一只眼睛看他：“哥，你高考数学多少分？”

    “别提了。”

    “说明你也没做完。”

    林川没接话，嘴角抽了一下。

    火锅当天晚上就兑现了。四个人围着一口鸳鸯锅，林母涮菜的速度比谁都快，一筷子一筷子全往林小冉碗里堆。

    “多吃点多吃点，瘦成啥了，考试那几天都没好好吃饭吧？”

    林小冉被堵得嘴巴鼓鼓的，含糊不清地“嗯嗯”着。

    林建国难得喝了两瓶啤酒，脸红到脖子根，拍着桌子说了一句：“咱老林家也要出大学生了！”

    整个包间都是热气和笑声。

    火锅涮到一半的时候，林川的手机响了。

    号码陌生，区号是江城本地的。

    他接起来，听了三十秒，放下筷子。

    “什么事？”林建国看他表情变了。

    “经开区拆迁办。”林川把手机揣回兜里，若无其事地笑着说。

    “通知我后天去签字。厂子那块地，正式启动拆迁了。”

    六月十五号。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Jiangcheng in June is like a steamer, the lid is tightly covered, and the heat penetrates into the bones.

The central air conditioning in Jade Garden runs 24 hours a day, making the living room as cool as another season.

But Mother Lin still couldn't change her old habit. She opened all the windows early in the morning to ventilate them, but Lin Chuan pushed them back three times.

“Mom, please don’t open the window if you want to turn on the air conditioner.”

"There is no charge for electricity?"

"Ham, our family is not bad at this either."

Mother Lin muttered "Prodigal" and closed the window with her hands.

June 7th.

The first day of the college entrance examination.

Lin Chuan drove his car to the gate of the community and waited there early in the morning.When Lin Xiaoran came out of the unit door, her ponytail was tied high, she was carrying a washed white canvas schoolbag, and her steps were faster than usual.

She opened the car door and got in. Before fastening her seat belt, she lowered her head and flipped through her admission ticket.

"Nervous?"

"It's okay." Lin Xiaoran's voice was steady, but Lin Chuan noticed that her left hand had been rubbing the hem of her school uniform.

“I’ll treat you to hot pot after the exam.”

"Brother, the way you encourage people every time is to treat them to food."

“It just works.”

When the car stopped at the gate of Jiangcheng No. 1 Middle School, a large group of parents had already gathered outside the school gate.

Some were holding sunflowers, some were holding banners, and an aunt was holding a big loudspeaker and shouting "Victory!"

Lin Xiaoran opened the car door, took two steps, and then turned back.

"Brother."

"Huh?"

"I will perform exceedingly well."

After saying that, he turned around and ran into the school gate, his ponytail swaying in the sun.

Lin Chuan sat in the car, lit a cigarette, and looked at the noisy crowd at the school gate.

Two days.

After two days of exams, his last worries in Jiangcheng were temporarily put aside.

June 9th, the college entrance examination ends.

When Lin Xiaoran came out of the examination room, her whole body seemed to have been ripped away from the bones. She leaned limply on the car seat, her eyes closed, but the corners of her mouth were curved.

"How do you feel?"

“I haven’t finished the third question of the last big question in mathematics.”

"That means it's stable."

"Why?"

"The last question is originally prepared for people with perfect scores. It is normal for normal people to not be able to finish it."

Lin Xiaoran opened one eye and looked at him: "Brother, what is your score in mathematics in the college entrance examination?"

"Don't mention it."

"It means you haven't finished it yet."

Lin Chuan didn’t answer, and the corner of his mouth twitched.

The hot pot was delivered that night.Four people gathered around a mandarin duck pot. Mother Lin cooked the vegetables faster than anyone else, piling chopstick after chopstick into Lin Xiaoran's bowl.

"Eat more, eat more, why have you lost weight? You didn't eat well during the exam days, did you?"

Lin Xiaoran was so gagged that her mouth bulged, and she muttered "um huh" vaguely.

Lin Jianguo rarely drank two bottles of beer, and his face turned red to the root of his neck. He patted the table and said, "We, the old Lin family, are also going to have a college student!"

The whole private room was filled with heat and laughter.

Halfway through the hot pot cooking, Lin Chuan’s cell phone rang.

The number is unfamiliar, the area code is local to Jiangcheng.

He picked it up, listened for thirty seconds, and then put down his chopsticks.

"What's the matter?" Lin Jianguo saw his expression change.

“Economic Development Zone Demolition Office.” Lin Chuan put his phone back in his pocket and said with a nonchalant smile.

"Inform me to sign the day after tomorrow. The demolition of the factory land has officially started."

June 15th.
